# Bayesian inference

Comparing FBD with strict and relaxed clock. 

```{r}
results_bi = NULL
n = 199
#n = 10
pb = txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
for(i in 0:n){
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(file=paste("simulations_data/comp_strict_relaxed/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), strip_prefix = "ms_", attach = "star")
    # SC trees
    sc_trees = paste("simulations_data/comp_strict_relaxed/fbd_strict_", i, ".trees", sep = "")  
    rc_trees = paste("simulations_data/comp_strict_relaxed/fbd_lognorm_", i, ".trees", sep = "")
    SC = return_bi_trees(sc_trees, beast_bin_folder)
    RC = return_bi_trees(rc_trees, beast_bin_folder)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  preds <- list(SC_MCC      = SC$mcc_tree,
                SC_MRC      = SC$mrc_tree,
                RC_MCC      = RC$mcc_tree,
                RC_MRC      = RC$mrc_tree
  )
  results_bi <- rbind(results_bi, score_methods(preds, gt, tradition = i))
  
}
write.csv(file="results_bi.csv", results_bi)
```

```{r}
custom_names = c(
  SC_MCC    = "Strict (MCC)",
  RC_MCC    = "Relaxed (MCC)",
  SC_MRC    = "Strict (MRC)",
  RC_MRC    = "Relaxed (MRC)"
  )
library("patchwork")
pA = plot_metric_boxplots(results_bi, "quartet_div", ylab = "quartet  divergence", methods = custom_names)
pB = plot_metric_boxplots(results_bi, "cid", ylab = "gRF  dissimilarity", methods = custom_names)

fig <- wrap_plots(
  pA, pB,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = 1
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 1) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),          # Scales all text (axes, legends, titles)
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),    # Axis labels
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),     # Tick labels
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold") # A-F tags
  ) & coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.85))
fig
ggsave("BI_benchmark.png", fig, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300) 
```
